name: Terminal
description: Otty-inspired interactive terminal for PI-Desktop. Docks in the right work panel (no separate window), with tabs, cross-platform shell profiles, and copy/paste.

en.name: Terminal
en.description: Otty-inspired interactive terminal for PI-Desktop. Docks in the right work panel (no separate window), with tabs, cross-platform shell profiles, and copy/paste.
en.safetyNotes: This plugin launches a real login shell as your user through a bundled PTY helper (forkpty on macOS/Linux, ConPTY on Windows). Anything you can run in a system terminal can run here, including destructive commands. It does not persist transcripts, passwords, or shell history beyond an in-memory scrollback that dies with the plugin process. Uninstalling or disabling the plugin kills every session. The AI is not given a tool that writes to the PTY; agent command execution continues to use the host Bash tool.

zh-CN.name: 终端
zh-CN.description: 受 Otty 启发的 PI-Desktop 交互式终端，只停靠在右侧工作面板（无独立窗口）；支持多标签、跨平台 shell profile 与复制粘贴。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 本插件通过自带的 PTY 助手以当前用户身份拉起真正的登录 shell（macOS/Linux 为 forkpty，Windows 为 ConPTY）。系统终端能执行的命令这里都能执行，包括破坏性操作。插件不持久化 transcript、密码或 shell 历史，仅在进程内存中保留有限回滚缓冲，卸载或禁用即杀掉全部会话。AI 没有写入 PTY 的工具；模型执行命令仍走宿主 Bash。

author: PI-Desktop
changelog: Release 0.1.4: follows the app light/dark mode live in the work-panel view, including the xterm canvas (views have no appearance:changed push, so the plugin polls the host). Release 0.1.3: isolates PTY tabs per open project so switching workspaces cannot mix sessions. Release 0.1.2: docks only in the right work panel; the detached window is removed. Release 0.1.1: login-shell environment so GUI-launched sessions inherit PATH (pnpm, nvm, Homebrew, cargo, bun); denser Otty-like chrome with bottom tabs, find, and font-size controls. Release 0.1.0: first release. Multi-tab PTY sessions, cross-platform default shells (zsh / bash / PowerShell / optional Git Bash), theme and language following, and copy/paste.
safetyNotes: This plugin launches a real login shell as your user through a bundled PTY helper (forkpty on macOS/Linux, ConPTY on Windows). Anything you can run in a system terminal can run here, including destructive commands. It does not persist transcripts, passwords, or shell history beyond an in-memory scrollback that dies with the plugin process. Uninstalling or disabling the plugin kills every session. The AI is not given a tool that writes to the PTY; agent command execution continues to use the host Bash tool.
